terms.summary: The Horizons manual (References for the Horizons system) asks users to cite Giorgini and the JPL Solar System Dynamics Group with the system URL and retrieval date; the SSD About page gives a citation template for downloaded data. Neither page states a copyright notice, license, or redistribution restriction. The manual calls user-produced files informal releases that must not be used for purposes affecting spacecraft safety or mission success without contacting the JPL Solar System Dynamics Group. Formal third-party notices remain to be settled with D06/#9.
